content.value_statement: Broad Sent requests can involve several channels, operations, and compliance workflows. This skill clarifies intent and routes each request to the appropriate specialist.
actual_capabilities: Distinguishes live account operations from planning, compliance, diagnosis, and product design requests.
Routes contact, template, message, analytics, and account-readiness tasks to dedicated Sent skills.
Routes SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Sender Profile, delivery, and migration questions to specialist skills.
Asks focused questions about channel, workflow stage, geography, surface, audience, symptoms, and available artifacts.
Orders multi-step workflows so prerequisite checks happen before dependent operations.
Uses a bundled glossary to interpret Sent and messaging terminology.
limitations: Does not perform Sent operations directly.
Requires the referenced specialist skills and MCP operations to be available in the agent host.
Does not answer pricing, contracts, invoices, or unsupported product policy questions.
Current provider behavior and policies require live upstream documentation.

use_cases.title: Choose a Messaging Setup Path
use_cases.description: Clarify channel, geography, and workflow stage before selecting an onboarding or integration skill.

use_cases.title: Route a Delivery Problem
use_cases.description: Separate account readiness, registration, template rejection, routing, and delivery-analysis issues.

use_cases.title: Plan a Sent Integration
use_cases.description: Select integration, webhook, Sender Profile, two-way messaging, or migration guidance based on the system scope.

prompt_templates.title: Start With Sent
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me start using Sent. Ask one question at a time and route me to the appropriate workflow.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner has not selected a channel or task.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Messaging
prompt_templates.prompt: My Sent messaging is not working. Identify the channel, symptom, and available evidence, then select the correct diagnostic skill.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Multiple Workflows
prompt_templates.prompt: I need account setup, templates, and a live send. Order the required Sent workflows and begin with the prerequisite.
prompt_templates.scenario: A request spans several Sent operations.

prompt_templates.title: Route a Platform Integration
prompt_templates.prompt: We are building a multi-tenant messaging platform with webhooks and Sender Profiles. Clarify boundaries, then route each implementation stage.
prompt_templates.scenario: An architect needs coordinated specialist guidance.

output_examples.input: I want to use Sent for customer messaging.
output_examples.output: Which channel do you plan to use: SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, or are you still deciding?

output_examples.input: Our WhatsApp template was rejected by Meta.
output_examples.output: This belongs in the WhatsApp template authoring workflow. Provide the rejection reason and current template text for review.

output_examples.input: Check readiness, find my template, and send a test message.
output_examples.output: First verify account readiness. Then locate the template, preview the message, and request confirmation before sending.

best_practices: Provide the channel, geography, workflow stage, and desired outcome when known.
Share relevant identifiers or error details only after confirming they contain no sensitive data.
Complete prerequisite checks before requesting live messaging operations.
anti_patterns: Do not use the router when one specialist workflow is already clear.
Do not force a Sent route for generic engineering questions.
Do not request live mutations before account readiness and user intent are confirmed.

faq.question: Does this skill send messages?
faq.answer: No. It routes sending requests to the dedicated messaging skill.

faq.question: Which channels does it recognize?
faq.answer: It recognizes SMS, WhatsApp, and RCS workflows.

faq.question: Can it route account and contact tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. It routes account readiness, contacts, templates, messaging, and analytics to dedicated operational skills.

faq.question: Can it answer Sent pricing questions?
faq.answer: No. Pricing, contracts, invoices, and unsupported account access questions should go to Sent documentation or support.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the channel, workflow stage, geography, system surface, symptom, and available artifact when relevant.

faq.question: Can it coordinate several Sent tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. It proposes an order and starts with the required prerequisite workflow.
